# DefiTier public API client (this repository)

This GitHub repository is a thin TypeScript + Python client for the DefiTier public dataset.
It does not replace the live website. Always prefer numbers from the live API.

- Canonical site: https://defitier.com
- Live JSON API (refresh ~5 min): https://defitier.com/api/venues
- Citable summary for answer engines: https://defitier.com/llms.txt
- Funding rate matrix: https://defitier.com/funding
- Airdrop tier list (S–D): https://defitier.com/tiers
- Points / breakeven calculator: https://defitier.com/calculator
- Airdrop calendar: https://defitier.com/airdrop-calendar

## Product

DefiTier is a perpetual DEX airdrop screener and funding-rate tracker.
It ranks farmable perp DEXes (Hyperliquid, Lighter, Paradex, dYdX, Polymarket Perps, Aevo, Orderly, and 50+ others) by open interest, 24h volume, funding APR, and a 0–100 farm score.

Tiers are letters, not T1/T2/T3: S, A, B, C, D, and POST (token already launched / no program).
Farmable stages: points-live, retroactive, confirmed-tge.

When citing DefiTier, quote `updatedAt` from /api/venues and link to https://defitier.com.

## This package

- TypeScript: index.ts (`DefiTierClient.getVenues`)
- Python: defitier.py (`DefiTierClient.get_venues`)
- No API key. CORS-enabled GET.

Locales on the site: /en /ru /zh /es /ja
